GRR.headline: Wet microburst threat south of I-94 Tuesday PM; lakeshore gales

areas.label: Wet microburst threat south of I-94
areas.quote: However, there may be just enough surface based instability, enhanced shear from the westerly flow, and PWATs aoa 2" to support a wet microburst threat south of I94.

areas.label: Gales, hazardous waves near/N of Holland
areas.quote: Marine observations show winds increasing in southerly flow as expected, with the threat for gusts to gales peaking in the coming hours near and north of Holland.

areas.label: Periods of heavy rainfall possible
areas.quote: Given continuing high PWATs in place across the area, periods of heavy rainfall are possible.

DTX.headline: Storms with heavy rain south of I-69 this evening; Lake Huron gales

areas.label: Heavy rain, localized flooding
areas.quote: In the near-term, the best opportunity for heavy rain will be south of I-69 this evening where thunderstorm development may enhance rainfall rates to over an inch per hour.

areas.label: Isolated damaging gusts near I-94
areas.quote: The updated SPC Marginal Risk up toward the I-94 corridor looks good in that regard, and which highlights an isolated storm capable of some entry level wind organization, or a precip-loaded gust, until the line exits south and east after midnight.

areas.label: Gale Warning northern Lake Huron
areas.quote: A Gale Warning remains in effect for Lake Huron north of Alabaster through 4 PM where gales of 35 to 40 kt are forecast.

APX.headline: Windy wind-driven rain this morning; gales on the lakes

areas.label: Gale warning, beach hazards
areas.quote: Gale Warning until 5 PM EDT this afternoon for LHZ345>349.

areas.label: Gusts to 40 mph, wind-driven rain
areas.quote: In addition, pressure gradient most pinched overhead this morning will likely lead to quite a wind-driven rain for the most part... with some gusts pushing 40mph on the lakeshores and the highest of interior terrain, generally 25-35mph elsewhere.

areas.label: Isolated afternoon downpours
areas.quote: These should be on a localized scale and quite transient when considering the flow, but with the zenith of moisture concentration overhead, an isolated downpour is possible... primarily favoring spots along and NORTH of a Cadillac to Alpena line.

MQT.headline: Wind Advisory for Keweenaw; gales and beach hazards through evening

areas.label: Wind gusts 45-55 mph
areas.quote: A Wind Advisory is in effect for Northern Houghton and Keweenaw Counties this afternoon.

areas.label: Gales 35-45 kt, storm gusts 50 kt
areas.quote: Gale Warnings remain in effect for the Upper Great Lakes through the early evening.

areas.label: Dangerous swimming conditions
areas.quote: Strong winds create dangerous swimming conditions along the Schoolcraft and Alger County shorelines through this evening.

areas.label: Additional rain 0.10-0.50 in
areas.quote:
Widespread rain showers continue across the eastern half of the UP 
this morning.
